text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on modeling potential future suitable habitat for individual tree species under climate change scenarios, not on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. It explicitly uses species distribution modeling (DISTRIB) based on environmental variables to project habitat suitability, not LULC classes or transitions. Although it produces spatially explicit maps of species importance values at a national scale (eastern US), its primary objective is ecological—assessing climate-driven shifts in tree species ranges—not predicting or simulating changes in land cover types (e.g., forest, cropland, urban). It meets several inclusion criteria (national scale, multiple scenarios, spatial modeling), but fails the core requirement that the primary focus be LULC prediction; instead, it falls under species-specific ecological modeling, which is excluded per the exclusion criterion "Species-specific/ecological focus (flora/fauna) unrelated to LULC".)
